name: Sisterly Lust
source:
Until recently you've lived in a different part of the country with your father. Your parents divorced when you were very little and the family was ripped apart after a fierce custody battle. Your mother took her three daughters home, while your father moved away with you. You haven't seen your family since and any attempts at communication were very much discouraged by your father. But now, everything has changed after his sudden death. 

During your father's funeral you were approached by a woman you instantly recognized as your mother. She asked if you would be willing to go home with her, meet your sisters and be a family again. You hesitantly said yes...
translation:
直到最近，你还和父亲住在这个国家的另一个地方。你的父母在你很小的时候就离婚了，在激烈的监护权争夺战中，家庭破裂了。你的母亲带着她的三个女儿回家，而你的父亲则和你一起搬走了。从那以后你就再也没有见过你的家人，你的父亲也非常不鼓励任何沟通的尝试。但现在，一切都因他的突然去世而改变了。

在你父亲的葬礼上，一位女士走近你，你立刻认出她就是你的母亲。她问你是否愿意和她一起回家，见见你的姐妹，重新成为一家人。你犹豫地说是…
